iPhone

  1. Download the file on your PC and install it on your iPhone with Sideloadly or AltStore, signing in with your Apple ID.
  2. On the iPhone: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → trust your Apple ID. Then Settings → Privacy & Security → turn on Developer Mode.
  3. Open Tethr Link, scan the QR code on your PC, then tap Set up notifications and accept the Bluetooth pairing on both.
